Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 9 · NFL Week 9 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 7, 2:48 PM ET

Josh Allen has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bills at Vikings DraftKings Showdown: 19.8 points at $11,400 FLEX, 29.8 at captain for $17,100. In a game totaled at 43.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.7 times, and across 10,000 simulations he holds 71% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Allen is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 6.6 points at an $11,400 FLEX salary.

James Cook III has the largest captain share: 21.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Cook at captain. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.4 targets. Josh Allen is the next captain in line, at 20.5%. The model has him running 6.7 times.

Buffalo is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 23.25 for the Bills and 20.25 for the Vikings.

Behind Allen and Cook, the next projections are Justin Jefferson (15.6, $9,800), Carson Wentz (15.2, $9,000) and T.J. Hockenson (10.7, $5,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 7, 2:48 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: James Cook III, BUF RB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

James Cook III holds 21.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 17.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Cook averaged 17.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.7 and a ceiling of 35.8. He holds 61% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 21.2% as the captain and 40.2% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Josh Allen, BUF QB ($11,400 FLEX / $17,100 CPT)

Josh Allen holds 20.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $17,100 and the 19.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.7 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 19.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 40.0. He holds 71% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 20.5% as the captain and 50.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Justin Jefferson, MIN WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Justin Jefferson holds 16.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 15.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 6.4 targets on 22.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 15.6 points with a simulated floor of 3.2 and a ceiling of 41.8. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.6% as the captain and 29.1% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Bills vs Vikings

Carson Wentz, MIN QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 9.6% as the captain and 47.1% in a FLEX spot.

T.J. Hockenson carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.7 DraftKings points for a $5,400 FLEX salary ($8,100 at captain). The model gives him 4.7 targets on 17.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Hockenson averaged 10.7 points with a simulated floor of 2.4 and a ceiling of 25.8. He holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.2% as the captain and 32.2% in a FLEX spot.

DJ Moore, BUF WR ($7,800 FLEX / $11,700 CPT)

DJ Moore carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.3 DraftKings points for a $7,800 FLEX salary ($11,700 at captain). The model gives him 3.9 targets on 15.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Moore averaged 10.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.2 and a ceiling of 22.3. He holds 30% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.2% as the captain and 27.3% in a FLEX spot.

Tyler Bass projects for 8.3 DraftKings points at a $4,600 FLEX salary, 1.81 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Bass averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 16.0. He holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.1% as the captain and 27.2% in a FLEX spot.

Bills projects for 6.4 DraftKings points at a $4,000 FLEX salary, 1.60 projected points per $1,000. Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown?

James Cook III holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 21.2%, ahead of Josh Allen (20.5%) and Justin Jefferson (16.6%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Bills vs Vikings?

Build around Carson Wentz at captain with Josh Allen, James Cook III and Justin Jefferson at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (13 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $4,900 for the last two FLEX spots.

Josh Allen leads the SPAGS model at 19.8 DraftKings points for $11,400 at FLEX, or 29.8 points at captain for $17,100.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Bills vs Vikings Showdown?

Josh Allen is the most expensive player at $11,400 FLEX and $17,100 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Tyler Bass (8.3 points at $4,600), Bills (6.4 points at $4,000) and Ty Johnson (5.3 points at $3,400).

What is the Bills vs Vikings spread and total?

The Bills are a 3-point favorite in a game totaled at 43.5, with implied team totals of 23.25 for the Bills and 20.25 for the Vikings.
